properties.name: BR028
properties.site-address: Lower Wharf Industrial Estate, Wallbridge Stroud
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: STROUD|This site could be redeveloped for a mix of housing and other uses including employment, tourism and leisure uses. Only the frontage land with Bath Road and land adjacent to the canal would be suitable for residential uses due to the floodplain. A relatively high density flatted development could be delivered, around 75-100 dph and the suggested yield is 12-17 units.
